titles.title: Protecting Older Americans Act of 2025
Protecting Older Americans Act of 2025
A bill to amend title 9 of the United States Code with respect to arbitration of disputes involving age discrimination.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

bill.summary:
Protecting Older Americans Act of 2025
This bill prohibits a predispute arbitration agreement or predispute joint-action waiver from being valid or enforceable with respect to a case relating to an age discrimination dispute at the election of the person alleging the discrimination.
